page.overview:
Who is Officer Lowery?

Officer Lowery is a minor character in the remake of .

They investigated to see what was going on and Lowery was told to check upstairs. He found Laurie with Tommy Doyal and Lindsey Wallace hiding in the bathroom. They asked if Michael Myers was still out there, and he told them no one was out there. He asked Laurie to unlock the door and, while he waited, he was stabbed in the back by Michael.
